answer.new_sentence: Declare GIVE, and choose GIVE when your partner also declares GIVE, since mutual giving earns +1 each; choose ASK when your partner declares TAKE, and never choose TAKE yourself.
Always declare GIVE, then choose GIVE against partners who declare GIVE, because GIVE with GIVE pays +1 each, and choose ASK against partners who declare TAKE to avoid losing 2.
Declare GIVE honestly, choose GIVE when your partner declares GIVE, choose ASK when your partner declares TAKE, and avoid TAKE since exposed TAKEs damage your public record.
Always declare GIVE yourself, and keep your own record free of exposed TAKEs so that partners trust you and choose GIVE in return.
Always declare GIVE yourself and never choose TAKE, because every TAKE can be exposed and then partners will refuse to cooperate with you.
Check your partner's recent exposed TAKEs, and if the record shows TAKEs, choose ASK even when they declare GIVE, since a false GIVE declaration followed by TAKE costs you 2.
Look at your partner's last exposed TAKEs and choose ASK against anyone with a recent TAKE, even if they declare GIVE, because declarations are not binding.
Before choosing GIVE, check your partner's recent exposed TAKEs, and choose ASK instead if the record shows TAKE, because declarations are not binding and GIVE against a TAKE costs you 2.
